text: *Draft 2:* We spend so much time building complex personal knowledge bases in digital tools, but we often overlook a massive blind spot: accessibility. We obsess over graph views and nested tags while forgetting how these structures fail accessibility tests. If our second brain isn't navigable via screen readers or keyboard-only shortcuts, it isn't a tool—it's a barrier. We need to start designing our digital gardens to be universal, ensuring our knowledge remains usable for everyone, forever.
